limitations: Selected agent-authored relevance labels across six institutional case families.

evidencePathIntegration.kind: Deterministic retained-evidence integration/source-closure check, not learned factual reasoning

perQuery.expectedEvidenceStop: No source-backed vehicle manufacturer, supplier invoice or ultimate private recipient is established. Do not infer a manufacturer from common government suppliers.
No beneficiary-level recovery ledger, cohort remittance or later accepted closure is established; no private beneficiary names should be generated.
The state-support → trust → related-party payment path is contextual, not proof of earmarked-grant diversion or a Chikkajala rent allocation.
No private media subcontractor, partisan beneficiary or individual cash recipient is established by the retained paragraph.
Do not infer full commitment payment, later conversion, current ownership or private bank-ledger verification from the 2023 disclosure.
The path stops at the jointly named award. Programme disbursement cannot be attributed to a contract, firm, person or misuse without downstream records.

evidencePathIntegration.abstentionScope: Expected evidence stops are retained editorial constraints. Without emitted predictions no learned abstention accuracy is claimed.
